name: partiful_explore
description: Browse Partiful's public explore page — trending and themed public events (parties, pop-ups, panels, meetups) people can crash. Pass a region code for a richer, city-specific set of themed sections (Halloween Parties, Pop-Ups & Markets, Meet Someone New, etc.); omit it for the top-level cross-city trending carousel (NYC/LA/SF). Only eight regions resolve: nyc, la, sf, dc, chi, bos, atx, mia — there is no broader city parameter.

region.description: Optional city region code: nyc, la, sf, dc, chi, bos, atx, or mia. Omit for the top-level NYC/LA/SF trending overview.

name: partiful_event
description: Full public detail for one Partiful event by id: title, description, start/end time, location, image, host display names, and aggregate RSVP counts (going/interested/approved — counts only, never a guest list or contact info). Get the event_id from partiful_explore's results, or from a partiful.com/e/<id> URL.

event_id.description: Partiful event id, e.g. "4Epl0nZZS9krY6WJVB9X" (the path segment after partiful.com/e/).
